name: Release Hygiene
objective: Prepare a project folder for public release by identifying files that should not be shipped.
brief: A project is almost ready for release, but it contains build cache, local reports and temporary files.
success_criteria: Identify local reports and cache folders.

artifacts.content: Synthetic cache placeholder. This should not be part of a release.\n

hints: Start with folders that are generated by the interpreter or build system.
Reports may reveal local paths and are not always intended for release.
A release should be reproducible and clean.
solution: The project should ship source, documentation and license files, but exclude __pycache__, local reports, temporary build output and generated artifacts unless they are intentionally part of the release.
